jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Commerce
jobs.location: Bellevue, Washington, United States; San Francisco, California, United States
jobs.description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The opportunity:

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join Flexport's product team and own a critical part of how we serve clients and operators across global logistics. You'll define the vision and roadmap for your product area, ship features that drive measurable business outcomes, and collaborate with engineering, design, commercial, and operations teams to solve hard problems at scale.

Flexport's platform powers every stage of global freight, from booking and pricing to visibility, customs, and delivery. The products you build will be used daily by logistics managers, supply chain leaders, freight operators, and internal teams who keep goods moving around the world. This is a high-impact role for someone who combines strong product instincts with deep analytical skills and comfort navigating complex domains.

The team:

The Commerce team owns the end-to-end quality, automation, and profitability of Flexport’s commerce domain. We build intelligent agents to automate critical commerce workflows, including quoting, billing, and invoicing, while driving cost intelligence across every shipment process gate to optimize profitability. Additionally, our team expands the marketplace catalog for new offerings and develops next-generation, client-facing commerce products and payments technology.

You will:

- Define and deliver product features that improve key commerce workflows for internal operators and clients across Flexport's platform

- Own your product area end-to-end, building and executing product roadmaps spanning 12 to 18 months

- Build intelligent AI agents to automate core commerce operations, including quoting, billing, and invoicing

- Partner with Engineering, Design, Sales, Operations, and other cross-functional teams to translate complex logistics workflows into clear, intuitive experiences

- Collaborate closely across a global footprint with engineering teams in the West Coast US and China, participating in regular cross-border syncs

- Use data to guide prioritization, measure impact, and identify opportunities

- Develop analytics frameworks to track product health, user engagement, and business outcomes

- Contribute to medium- and long-term product strategy, with opportunities to shape the future of the platform

You should have:

- 6+ years of product management experience, or other domain-relevant experience

- Demonstrated ability to lead product roadmaps spanning 12 to 18 months working closely with an engineering team and cross-functional partners

- Strong analytical and quantitative skills. You are comfortable working with complex datasets, building metrics frameworks, and using data to make decisions. SQL proficiency required

- A track record of shipping intuitive UX in data-dense, complex domains

- Experience building user-facing or operator-facing features that simplify multi-step workflows

- Ability to collaborate deeply with designers, engineers, and commercial or operations teams

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially around tradeoffs and prioritization

- Experience with B2B workflow software, supply chain platforms, or logistics technology is a plus

The Opportunity

As a Senior Product Manager at Flexport, you'll set the strategic vision and shape products that transform global logistics at scale. You’ll collaborate seamlessly with engineering, design, operations, and business teams to develop and iterate on solutions that power seamless, efficient movement of goods worldwide. Your leadership will guide the team to deliver products that empower businesses—large and small—to meet customer demands and succeed in global markets.

Omnichannel Fulfillment at Flexport

Omnichannel fulfillment sits at the heart of Flexport’s mission to make global commerce so easy that there would be more of it. By integrating logistics across e-commerce, retail, and direct-to-consumer channels, we enable merchants to deliver faster, more efficiently, and at lower cost. As Senior Product Manager, you'll lead the vision and execution for outbound fulfillment solutions, enabling fast and reliable deliveries for shoppers, driving innovation in an interconnected supply chain ecosystem for our merchants —and shaping the future of global trade. Learn more about Flexport Omnichannel here .

What You’ll Do

- Lead Product Strategy: Define the holistic vision, goals, and roadmap for outbound fulfillment products supporting Flexport’s Omnichannel business lines.

- Executive communication: Managing relationships and reporting with C-suite leadership across Flexport and our customers / stakeholders

- Drive Strategy & Product Development: Own end-to-end strategy & product lifecycle, from ideation, writing requirements/BRDs, through launch and iteration, ensuring alignment with customer and business objectives.

- Partner Cross-Functionally: Work closely with engineering, design, operations, and data science teams to establish priorities, deliver scalable, impactful solutions.

- Champion Customer Insights: Gather and synthesize feedback from users, partners, and market research to inform product direction and prioritization.

- Mentor and Inspire: Provide guidance and mentorship to junior product managers, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

- Shape the Platform: Act as a key stakeholder in defining and evolving Flexport’s Omnichannel product vision and strategy.

- Drive Results: Measure product performance and iterate on features to maximize impact and business value.

What You Bring

- 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of launching and scaling high-impact products in e-commerce environments.

- Demonstrated leadership of cross-functional teams and delivery of complex projects from concept to execution.

- Depth in product lifecycle management, from discovery through to execution and post-launch evolution.

- Experience mentoring and coaching other product managers or team members.

- Exceptional communication and collaboration skills—you can influence without authority and build trust across stakeholders.

- Strategic thinker with strong prioritization skills—adept at framing trade-offs and navigating fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

- Strong writing skills to communicate your product vision, roadmap, requirements, launches, and impact to a broad range of stakeholders, from the CEO to an operator.

Bonus Points

- Experience building products for logistics, supply chain, and fulfillment.

- Hands-on exposure to AI or large language model (LLM) technologies to drive innovation or operational excellence.

- A passion for simplifying and accelerating global trade.

- Familiarity with agile product development methodologies.

Join Flexport’s Fulfillment Outbounds team and help shape the way goods move around the globe.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.location: Hong Kong; Shanghai, China; Shenzhen, China
jobs.description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own strategy across Ops Tech—the operational backbone of Flexport's freight forwarding business—and lead the build of an AI-powered freight operating system that automates the majority of work our operators do today. This is not a single-feature role, and it's not incremental tooling. You will define the vision for how multiple operational product surfaces work together across the shipment lifecycle—from exception handling to end-to-end task automation—then execute against that vision with a high degree of autonomy.

This role sits at the intersection of product, operations, and business outcomes. The systems you build will directly move Flexport's cost structure, throughput, and service quality, so you'll be measured not by features shipped but by the operational and financial impact you realize. You'll also be reengineering how the business runs: designing the product often means redesigning the operating process itself, and persuading operations and commercial leaders to adopt a new operating model. Think of it as equal parts product management, process engineering, and internal consulting—at a scope that spans multiple engineering teams and other PMs.

You will raise the bar for the PM team through mentorship, better frameworks, and sharper thinking on the hardest product problems we face. This is a role for someone with deep product experience, strong analytical instincts, and the ability to operate at both the strategic and execution level in a complex, data-rich environment.

What You'll Do

- Own the vision and strategy for the AI-powered freight operating system. Define how multiple operational surfaces work together to automate work end-to-end—identifying the highest-leverage workflows, sequencing investment, designing AI/automation solutions that handle them, and progressively removing humans from the loop while improving accuracy and speed.

- Drive business impact, not just product output. Tie every initiative to a measurable business result—cost savings, productivity per operator, cycle time, error reduction, margin. Define the metrics, instrument them, and own the P&L-level outcomes of what your domain ships.

- Reengineer operations, don't just digitize them. Map and redesign the underlying operational processes before automating them. Bring strong process-engineering and consulting skills to challenge how work is done today and influence operations and commercial stakeholders toward a new, leaner operating model.

- Own your domain end-to-end, from problem discovery and process diagnosis through launch, adoption, and iteration across the workflows and teams in your area.

- Partner deeply across functions—Engineering, Design, Operations, Commercial, and regional leaders—to align competing priorities and translate complex, multi-step logistics workflows into automated, intuitive systems delivered as cohesive experiences.

- Use data to set direction, not just measure results. Build metrics frameworks that connect automation rates, operator adoption, product health, and business outcomes, and use them to guide where to invest next across your domain.

- Represent your domain in leadership forums, influencing resource allocation and strategic direction for how Flexport's operations scale through software and AI.

- Mentor PMs on the team: raise the bar for how we write specs, prioritize, communicate trade-offs, and ship.

What You Should Have

- 8+ years of product management experience.

- Demonstrated ability to own a product domain (not just a feature or single product area) and drive outcomes across multiple teams.

- A track record of building products that delivered quantifiable business impact (e.g., cost reduction, automation of manual work, throughput gains)—and a default of measuring success in business terms, not feature counts.

- Demonstrated operational process engineering and consulting ability: you can diagnose how a complex process works, redesign it, and influence stakeholders to adopt a new operating model.

- Experience building automation, workflow, or AI-powered products that replaced or significantly reduced manual human effort.

- Strong analytical and quantitative skills. You build metrics frameworks, write your own queries, and use data to settle debates. SQL proficiency required.

- A track record of shipping intuitive UX in data-dense, complex domains where the user workflow spans multiple steps or systems.

- Experience aligning cross-functional teams (engineering, design, operations, commercial) around a shared roadmap when priorities compete.

- Proven ability to operate at the strategy level (where should we invest, and why) and the execution level (what ships this quarter, and what does "done" look like) in the same week.

- Excellent written and verbal communication, especially the ability to frame trade-offs, present recommendations to senior leadership, and create clarity in ambiguous situations.

- Experience mentoring or leading other PMs, formally or informally.

- Experience with B2B workflow software, supply chain platforms, or logistics technology is a plus.

- Experience in logistics, freight forwarding, or supply chain operations is highly desirable.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

The Visibility team owns the end-to-end mapping and tracking of physical goods across global logistics. We solve complex supply chain workflows at the system root-cause level using data, product intuition, and highly structured logic. Our team is responsible for defining the client-facing tracking experience based on real physical execution capabilities, driving operational and system changes across execution, planning, and technology teams.

You will:

- Define and drive product strategy across the Visibility domain that spans multiple teams, user types, or workflow stages

- Own the end-to-end mapping, tracking, and visibility of physical goods across the entire shipment lifecycle

- Drive end-to-end data intelligence to solve complex operational problems and define next-generation client-facing visibility experiences

- Partner across execution, planning, and technology teams to align priorities and ship integrated systems across surfaces

- Collaborate closely across a global footprint (Hong Kong, Europe, US) with China engineering teams, participating in regular cross-border syncs

- Use data to set direction, not just measure results. Building metrics frameworks that connect product usage to business outcomes and using them to guide investment decisions across your domain

- Break down ambiguous, cross-cutting problems into concrete product plans that multiple teams can execute against

- Represent your domain in leadership forums, influencing resource allocation and strategic direction

- Mentor PMs on the team: improving how we write specs, prioritize, communicate trade-offs, and ship

You should have:

- 8+ years of product management experience

- Background solving complex logistics, physical operational, or system root-cause problems using algorithmic planning, data analysis, and structured logic

- Demonstrated ability to own a product domain (not just a feature or single product area) and lead product roadmaps spanning 2 to 3 years across multiple engineering teams

- Strong analytical and quantitative skills. You build metrics frameworks, write your own queries, and use data to settle debates. SQL proficiency required

- A track record of shi pping products in data-dense, physical, or multi-sided domains where user workflows span multiple systems and operational teams

- Experience aligning multiple cross-functional teams (engineering, design, operations, commercial) around a shared roadmap when priorities compete

- Proven ability to operate at the strategy level (where should we invest, and why) and the execution level (what ships this quarter, and what does "done" look like) in the same week

- Excellent written and verbal communication, especially the ability to frame trade-offs, present recommendations to senior leadership, and create clarity in ambiguous situations

- Experience mentoring or leading other PMs, formally or informally

- Experience with B2B workflow software, supply chain platforms, or logistics technology is a plus

jobs.description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Technical Program Manager II, Omnichannel

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make it easy and accessible for everyone. We’re shaping the future of a $8.6T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The opportunity:

Omnichannel team is looking for a Technical Program Manager II to deliver cross-functional programs and lead the growth of business across Omnichannel organization. Omnichannel Technology powers critical areas including inbound, inventory, fulfillment, warehouse systems, carrier networks, parcel, and B2B/D2C distribution. These domains are highly interconnected and require strong coordination across Engineering, Product, Operations, and merchant-facing teams.

In this role, you will serve as a highly visible leader responsible for driving the communication, coordination, and execution of programs across their full lifecycle. You will partner closely with senior product and engineering leaders to define roadmaps, manage dependencies, secure resources, and ensure commitments are delivered on time. You will also establish processes that strengthen teamwork, communication, collaboration, and accountability across diverse teams with competing priorities. Beyond internal execution, you will engage directly with key merchants to understand their feedback, address concerns and escalations, and coordinate across Flexport to ensure issues are resolved efficiently and effectively.

You will

- Lead high-impact technology programs spanning multiple engineering teams, product domains, and business functions.

- Define clear goals, milestones, owners, dependencies, and success metrics.

- Build realistic program plans and hold teams accountable to committed deliverables.

- Proactively identify risks, blockers, and conflicts and drive them to resolution.

- Coordinate cross-team dependencies and align roadmaps across Engineering, Product, and Operations.

- Provide clear visibility into program progress, risks, decisions, and trade-offs.

- Drive launch readiness, operational readiness, migrations, and other critical cross-functional initiatives.

- Support annual and quarterly planning, including prioritization, estimation, capacity planning, and resource alignment.

- Establish effective processes that improve execution and predictability across the Omnichannel organization.

- Act as a trusted technical partner for key merchants using Flexport's Omnichannel products and services.

- Regularly engage with merchants to understand their experience, feedback, concerns, technical challenges, and escalations.

- Develop a strong understanding of Flexport's Omnichannel technology so you can effectively diagnose and contextualize merchant problems.

- Triage merchant issues and coordinate across Engineering, Product, Operations, Support, and other teams to drive timely resolution.

- Proactively manage merchant expectations and maintain clear communication throughout critical issues and escalations.

- Identify recurring merchant pain points and translate them into actionable product, technology, or operational improvements.

You Should Have

- 5+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering, product, technical account management, or a related technology role.

- Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional programs across multiple engineering teams.

- Strong program planning, execution, dependency management, and risk management skills.

- Ability to understand complex technical systems and effectively partner with engineering leaders.

- Experience working directly with customers or enterprise clients, including managing technical issues and escalations.

- Strong ability to translate customer problems into clear technical and operational actions.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across both internal teams and external partners.

- Ability to influence and drive execution without direct authority.

- Strong ownership, judgment, and bias toward action.

- Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and bring structure to complex problems.

- A data-driven mindset and strong focus on measurable outcomes.

- Experience in logistics, fulfillment, e-commerce, warehouse technology, transportation, or large-scale platform programs is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Omnichannel TPM makes complex programs easier to execute and merchant relationships easier to manage.

They create clarity, identify risks early, align teams around shared goals, and ensure critical initiatives deliver measurable outcomes. They also build strong relationships with merchants, understand their challenges, and ensure Flexport responds quickly and effectively when issues arise.

The goal is not more process – it is better execution, stronger accountability, and a better merchant experience across Flexport's Omnichannel network.
